DANCE FAVORS

FAERIE RINGRadiance Actions
Swap your Radiance with a rival; you receive the card you could see on their stand.
Look at your own Radiance.
FAERIE FORTWisp Actions
Lure a Wisp into a different Court.
Snuff two Wisps, from any Courts.
FAERIE MOUNDCourt Actions
Swap your Court with a rival; both of you see your new allegiance.
Look at a rival's Court.
FAERIE BRIDGEMagik + Stone
Gain a Faerie Magik card (always), then you must move or flip a stone.
Move a conjured stone to a dance’s outer end; its Glamours ride along (no tumble).
Gain a Faerie Magik card, then flip a stone. Anyone on it tumbles from the dance.
Every finished dance unveils a Wisp first. With enough Wisps gathered, a favor may be Call for your True Name.
